description: Lists Salesforce contacts using a SOQL query with filtering, sorting, and field selection, returning one page with pagination indicators. Records must include Id, and fields outside the response schema are not preserved.

query.default: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, Title, Department, AccountId FROM Contact
query.description: SOQL query to fetch contacts. Use standard SOQL syntax to filter, sort, and limit results. String literals must be single-quoted. Use correct field API names and relationship traversal (e.g., `Account.Industry`). To filter unassociated contacts use `AccountId = NULL`. Omitting an `AccountId` or `Account.Name` filter returns contacts across all accounts. Nullable fields like `LastActivityDate` require explicit null checks; use `ORDER BY ... NULLS FIRST` for null-safe sorting.
examples: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName FROM Contact WHERE Email != null
SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Contact ORDER BY LastName LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE CreatedDate = TODAY
query.human_parameter_description: Enter a SOQL query to specify which contacts to retrieve and which fields to return. Use this to filter, sort, or limit results; keep the default if you want a ready-made example.
query.title: Query
